title: A weekend in London
instructions: Ali Londra'daki hafta sonunu anlatıyor. En uzun metinlerden; geçmiş zaman, günler ve planlar değişiyor. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Last weekend I went to London with my friend Kerem.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: We went by train on Friday evening. It was cheap, only twenty pounds.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Our hotel was small but clean, and it was near a big park.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: On Saturday morning, we wanted to visit the Tower of London, but there were a lot of people.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: So we went to the British Museum. It was free and very interesting.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: For lunch, we had fish and chips. Kerem loved it, but I didn't like it very much.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: In the afternoon, it rained, so we went shopping. I bought a red umbrella and a book.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: On Saturday evening, we saw a musical. The tickets were expensive, but the show was fantastic.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: On Sunday, the weather was beautiful. We walked by the river and took a lot of photos.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: We came home on Sunday night at eleven. We were very tired, but happy.

script.speaker: ali
script.text: Next time, I want to stay for a week.

questions.prompt: How did Ali and Kerem go to London?
questions.evidence: We went by train on Friday evening.

questions.prompt: Why didn't they visit the Tower of London?
options: There were a lot of people.
questions.feedback: Gitmek istediler ama çok kalabalıktı (there were a lot of people), bu yüzden müzeye gittiler.
questions.evidence: but there were a lot of people.

options: He didn't like it very much.
questions.feedback: Kerem bayıldı ama Ali pek sevmedi (I didn't like it very much).
questions.evidence: but I didn't like it very much.
